# Inventory ETL pipeline

*Client industry: healthcare | Completed: 2023-10-26 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p08*

## The problem
The client was a pharmacy chain with stale stock numbers.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, extract-transform-load jobs, scheduled DAG-based pipelines, PostgreSQL. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project refreshed stock levels every hour instead of weekly.
